notes: Boot harl_a13 with four balls on trough switches 11-14, the stacking opto 15 at 0 and the motorcycle down on 36, with PinMAME's built-in motorcycle mechanism off. Walk the Portals service menu with the Black ENTER button (public 0) into the Switch Test as harl-a13-switch-test does, and close the motorcycle trough positions 41-44 and the super VUK 45 one at a time, reading the display 1.2 s after each closure: the full sweep read NONE for these five at 0.7 s, because the ROM prints their names only about a second after they close.
